query:
By Session 2, what pattern of attendance has the group come to anticipate from one specific member, and what in Josh's framing of the situation signals that the group has already adjusted to it?

Options:
A. Josh
B. Leon
C. Mei
D. Priya
context:
[1] (about=Josh, episodic, t1 @2025-10-13T09:02:00) Good to see you both last night 🍻 Priya you look really well. Mei, your team sounds intense. Leon didn't come again.
[2] (about=Josh, episodic, t0 @2025-10-06T14:44:00) classic Leon response 😂 we'll have your booth ready in case
agent_answer:
The member is **B. Leon**.

The group has come to anticipate that Leon will not show up. Josh signals this in two ways: at Session 2 he says **"Leon didn't come again"** — the word "again" marks it as a recurring, expected absence — and in the earlier message he calls it **"classic Leon response"** while adding **"we'll have your booth ready in case,"** showing the group has already adjusted by keeping his spot available even though they expect him not to attend.
